install.notes: The upstream simulator requires Linux x86_64 and an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12.8+ (README.md:14-20) and pulls CUDA-enabled wheels of warp-lang, newton and torch (pyproject.toml:27-30, ~10 GB). The gate and the fake backend need none of it: fake.py is pure Python and package code never imports the clone. Install the upstream only to serve a real environment, which was not run.
